about_the_game:
Panzer Deck is a 2D tactical card-based war game that thrusts you into the Western Front of World War II. Strategically deploy resources on the board to recruit units from infantry to tanks, and equipment like anti-tank guns or air support. Use maneuver cards to reposition forces, maximize their potential, and unleash powerful card combos that reflect unit synergy. Carefully positioned units, such as infantry backed by tanks or artillery , unlock unique abilities, letting you outmaneuver foes in critical battle moments.

Resource Management

In Panzer Deck, strategic resource management is key to victory. Carefully deploy resources like Ammunition, Fuel, and Food Supplies to recruit units such as tanks, artillery, or infantry, and equip them with gear like anti-tank guns or air support. Each resource fuels your war machine, but choices matter: don’t overcommit to one unit type. Plan wisely to balance recruitment and equipment, ensuring your forces are ready for the Western Front’s grueling battles. Inspired by WWII logistics, every decision shapes your ability to dominate the battlefield.

Combat

Panzer Deck hinges on tactical unit placement on the battlefield. Each unit, such as tanks, infantry, or artillery, has unique strengths and weaknesses. Positioning is critical, so you should place tanks to absorb damage and infantry to hold key points. Use maneuver cards to reposition forces, exploiting enemy vulnerabilities. Success depends on leveraging your units abilities and anticipating foes moves. Inspired by WWII’s Western Front, battles reward foresight and adaptability. Master the art of deployment to turn the tide and secure victory in intense, historically flavored clashes.

Cards

Panzer Deck features a diverse card system split into four categories: Resources, Unit Recruitment, Tactical Operations, and Maneuvers. Each turn, draw 10 new cards, with the option to swap three for strategic flexibility. Plan ahead to combine cards effectively use Resources to recruit, Maneuvers to reposition, and Tactical Operations for surprise advantages. Your hand shapes your strategy, so adapt to outsmart opponents. Inspired by WWII tactics, the card system rewards clever planning, letting you orchestrate devastating combos to dominate the Western Front.

What Panzer Deck offers:

  • A unique blend of logic puzzles and combat

  • Significant challenge with simple gameplay rules

  • High replayability

  • Freedom in how you approach gameplay

  • Beautiful, hand-drawn artwork

  • Historically accurate unit designs and World War II setting

What Panzer Deck is NOT:

  • A 4X strategy game

  • A tactical battlefield simulation

  • A game with realistic resource management
